_comment: Conformance cases for container addresses: '<path>[/<member>...]'. The container is the shortest leading prefix of the address that is an existing regular FILE (directories never are); everything after it is the member path ('' = the whole container). 'files' and 'dirs' are created relative to a temporary root before each case; addresses are relative to that root. Every implementation (ptolib C++ and Python, tttrlib, chisurf) runs this table. The '|' selector of earlier versions is not an address separator: it is an ordinary character in a file name.

cases.name: member name with spaces and hash
nested: a container inside a project
a directory named like a container is a directory
nothing exists: the whole address is a path
pipe is part of a file name, not a separator
